page.overview:
Who is Idyl?

is a slyborne human seraph played by Travis Willingham in Age of Umbra.

Idyl is a human man with a shaved head, wearing furs and basic clothing.

He is responsible and loyal to people he trusts, and he tries to protect them, even if they don't want him to.

At some point in his life Idyl started manifesting divine magic which his mother had always believed in, even if he hadn't; given the lack of godly presence in the world he decided to keep that part of himself hidden, especially since their current home had a tendency of suppressing of manipulating any sign of divine power. Since not even Idyl's mother wanted him to explore what his mother could do, he left by himself, and eventually moved to Desperloch. He met Eryn Loathroot near the settlement when she was being chased by a creature, and became friends with both her and her father, Garrick. He and Eryn spent a lot of time together and had an interest in the activity of the local delvers in the vaults. At one point, Idyl had asked for permission to join the delvers, but had apparently been turned down.
